cards.summaryEn: Reinforcement learning portfolio policies lack calibrated pre-trade risk certificates. The authors propose Gated Conformal Semantic Risk Control, which uses an instruction-tuned language model to map disclosures into semantic risk states, calibrates conformal radii to build uncertainty sets, and checks PPO proposals via an asymmetric second-order cone gate. In U.S. sector ETF backtests, the gated strategy eliminated semantic limit violations with annual return of 11.7% vs. 12.7% for raw PPO, and control experiments failed to reproduce the certificate.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from walk-forward out-of-sample backtests on nine U.S. sector SPDR ETFs, not other asset classes or market regimes; semantic risk states depend on language model mapping, whose robustness and cross-sample generalization are unverified; the return-compliance trade-off is specific to the backtest period and should not be taken as investment advice.
cards.originalTitle: Conformal Risk Certificates for Portfolio Optimization Under Uncertainty: A Gated Reinforcement-Learning Approach
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes Gated Conformal Semantic Risk Control, separating return-seeking reinforcement learning allocation from text-conditioned downside risk verification, eliminating risk limit violations while retaining returns.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自九只美国行业SPDR ETF的走样本外回测，未涉及其他资产类别或市场状态；语义风险状态依赖语言模型映射，其稳健性和跨样本泛化能力未经验证；收益与合规的权衡基于特定回测期，不应视为投资建议。
cards.description: 提出门控共形语义风险控制方法，将收益寻求的强化学习分配与文本条件下行风险验证分离，在保持收益的同时消除风险限额违规。
cards.titleEn: Gated Conformal Risk Certificates for Portfolio Optimization with Pre-Trade Audit
cards.whyItMatters: 为自动化投资组合系统提供可重放、可解释的交易前风险审计机制，有助于满足监管对风险限额和人工监督的期望。
cards.title: 门控共形风险证书为投资组合优化提供交易前审计
keyPointsEn: Gated Conformal Semantic Risk Control separates return allocation from text-conditioned risk verification, intervening only when proposals exceed a certified loss budget.
In walk-forward out-of-sample tests on nine U.S. Select Sector SPDR ETFs, the gated strategy eliminated all semantic limit violations, with 11.7% annual return vs. 12.7% for raw PPO.
Loughran-McDonald lexicon and time-shuffled text controls failed to reproduce the risk certificate.
keyPoints: 门控共形语义风险控制将收益分配与文本条件风险验证分离，仅在提案超出认证损失预算时干预。
在九只美国行业SPDR ETF走样本外测试中，门控策略消除所有语义限额违规，年化收益为11.7%，原始PPO为12.7%。
Loughran-McDonald词典控制和时间打乱文本控制均未能复现该风险证书。
cards.summary: 强化学习投资组合策略缺乏交易前校准的风险证书。作者提出门控共形语义风险控制，用指令微调语言模型将披露文本映射为语义风险状态，校准共形半径构建不确定性集，并通过不对称二阶锥门控检查PPO提案。在美国行业ETF回测中，门控策略消除了语义限额违规，年化收益从12.7%降至11.7%，且控制实验未能复现该证书。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides a replayable, interpretable pre-trade risk audit mechanism for automated portfolio systems, helping meet regulatory expectations for risk limits and human oversight.

cards.summaryEn: The research examines five seasonality anomalies across bond, commodity, and equity futures, finding excess returns not explained by carry, momentum, or skewness factors. The authors fit nonlinear seasonality models at the individual market level using statistical learning and conduct out-of-sample tests. Results show fast seasonality (day-of-week, day-of-month) has strong gross but extremely high turnover and negative net performance, while slower seasonality (day-of-half-year, day-of-year) yields positive gross and net performance, except day-of-quarter.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on the authors' global futures sample and out-of-sample backtests; conclusions depend on transaction cost assumptions, market coverage, and statistical learning model specifications. Negative net performance for fast seasonality indicates not all seasonal signals are profitable in practice. Economic rationales are candidate hypotheses, not settled conclusions. The roughly 30% Sharpe ratio increase when adding seasonality to a global factor portfolio is a full-evaluation-period result and may not be robust in subperiods or under different costs.
cards.descriptionEn: The study treats seasonality as an independent factor in global futures markets, fitting nonlinear models per market, and finds that slower seasonal patterns retain positive net returns after transaction costs and are uncorrelated with classic time-series factors.
cards.limitations: 证据基于作者构建的全球期货样本与样本外回测，结论受交易成本假设、市场覆盖范围与统计学习方法设定影响；快速季节性净收益为负，说明并非所有季节性信号可实盘获利；经济解释属候选假说，未形成定论；纳入全球因子组合后夏普比率提升约30%为全评估期结果，未必在子区间或不同成本下稳健。
cards.description: 该研究将季节性作为全球期货市场的独立因子，采用非线性模型逐市场拟合，发现慢速季节性模式在扣除交易成本后仍能提供正收益，且与经典时序因子不相关。
cards.titleEn: Global Seasonality Factor Investing: Slower Seasonal Patterns Deliver Better Net Returns
cards.whyItMatters: 为全球多资产因子配置提供了与传统时序因子低相关的补充信号来源；同时明确区分快速与慢速季节性的成本敏感性，对因子筛选和交易执行有直接参考价值。
cards.title: 全球季节性因子投资：慢速季节性净收益更优
keyPointsEn: Five seasonality anomalies are pervasive across bond, commodity, and equity futures and are not explained by global time-series carry, momentum, and skewness factors.
Fast seasonality (day-of-week, day-of-month) has strong gross performance but extremely high turnover, resulting in negative net performance after transaction costs.

Slower seasonality (day-of-half-year, day-of-year) produces positive gross and net performance; day-of-quarter is negative net; an equal-weight ensemble of seasonality models has an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio competitive with and uncorrelated to established factor portfolios.
keyPoints: 五类季节性异象在债券、商品和股票期货中普遍存在，且不能被全球时序 carry、动量和偏度因子解释。
快速季节性（星期、月内日）毛收益强但换手极高，扣除交易成本后净收益为负。
慢速季节性（半年内日、年内日）毛收益和净收益均为正；季度内日净收益为负；等权季节性模型组合的样本外夏普比率与经典因子组合相当且不相关。
cards.summary: 研究检验了债券、商品和股票期货市场中五类季节性异象，发现其超额收益无法被 carry、动量与偏度因子解释。作者采用统计学习拟合逐市场非线性季节性模型，并做样本外检验。结果显示快速季节性（星期、月内日）毛收益强但换手极高、净收益为负，而慢速季节性（季度内日、半年内日、年内日）除季度内日外净收益为正。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a supplementary signal source for global multi-asset factor allocation that is lowly correlated with traditional time-series factors; by explicitly distinguishing cost sensitivity between fast and slow seasonality, it provides direct reference for factor screening and trade execution.

cards.summaryEn: Existing portfolio construction methods are either agnostic to idiosyncratic shocks (standard factor models) or to the latent data structure driving systematic returns (recent graph-based approaches). MINGLE redefines graph locality via systematic factor exposure profiles and jointly learns a latent factor representation and its induced graph topology within a unified ADMM framework. The authors report that the exposure-similarity graph aligns more closely with established economic sectors than conventional correlation-based graphs, and that portfolios built from it consistently outperform correlation-based counterparts across volatility regimes and transaction cost levels, with paired statistical testing attributing the gains to the reconciliation of the graph and factor domains.
cards.limitationsEn: The input provides only the authors' methodological overview and concluding claims, without datasets, sample periods, benchmark specifications, statistical test details, or effect sizes, so generalisability and significance cannot be independently assessed. All stated findings (closer alignment with economic sectors, consistent outperformance over correlation-based methods, gains stemming from domain reconciliation) are author claims pending independent replication across markets and asset classes. The framework relies on joint ADMM optimisation, whose convergence, hyperparameter sensitivity, and computational cost are not described in the input.
cards.originalTitle: Beyond Co-Movement: Locality by Exposures Enables a Joint Factor-Graph Framework for Portfolio Diversification
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces MINGLE, a framework that redefines graph locality through systematic factor exposure profiles rather than observed co-movement, linking the factor and graph domains. Its novelty lies in jointly regularising both domains via ADMM to learn a latent factor representation and its induced graph topology directly from market returns; its usefulness is that the resulting exposure-similarity graph aligns more closely with established economic sectors and supports
cards.limitations: 输入仅提供作者对方法的概述与结论性表述，未给出数据集、样本区间、基准设定、统计检验细节与效应量，难以独立评估其普适性与显著性。文中结论（更贴近经济部门、持续优于相关性方法、增益源于两域对齐）均属作者主张，需待独立复现与不同市场、不同资产类别的验证。此外，框架依赖 ADMM 联合优化，其收敛性、超参数敏感性与计算成本在输入中未说明。
cards.description: 该研究提出 MINGLE 框架，用系统性因子暴露剖面而非观测到的协同波动来定义图局部性，从而在因子模型与图方法之间建立互补。其新意在于把因子与图两个域通过 ADMM 联合正则化，直接从市场收益中同时学习潜在因子表示及其诱导的图拓扑；有用性在于据此构建的暴露相似性图更贴近既有经济部门划分，并在多种波动状态和交易成本水平下表现优于基于相关性的对照组合。
cards.titleEn: Defining Graph Locality via Factor Exposures: A Joint Factor-Graph Framework for Portfolio Diversification
cards.whyItMatters: 若因子暴露能更稳定地刻画资产间的结构性关联，组合分散化便可直接作用于潜在市场结构，而非依赖观测到的协同波动及其有限样本伪影，这在不同的波动状态和交易成本水平下都可能更具稳健性。
cards.title: 以因子暴露定义图局部性：因子-图联合框架改进组合分散化
keyPointsEn: Defining graph locality via systematic factor exposure profiles rather than observed co-movement is the core mechanism of MINGLE.
A unified ADMM framework jointly learns a latent factor representation and its induced graph topology from market returns.

The exposure-similarity graph aligns more closely with established economic sectors than conventional correlation graphs, and paired statistical tests attribute portfolio gains to the reconciliation of the graph and factor domains.
keyPoints: 用系统性因子暴露剖面而非观测协同波动定义图局部性，是 MINGLE 的核心机制。
统一的 ADMM 框架从市场收益中联合学习潜在因子表示及其诱导的图拓扑。
暴露相似性图与既有经济部门划分的对齐程度高于传统相关性图，配对统计检验将组合增益归因于图与因子域的对齐。
cards.summary: 现有组合构建方法要么忽略特质冲击（标准因子模型），要么忽略驱动系统性收益的潜在数据结构（近期图方法）。MINGLE 以系统性因子暴露剖面重新定义图局部性，并通过统一的 ADMM 框架联合学习潜在因子表示与其诱导的图拓扑。作者报告该暴露相似性图比传统相关性图更接近既有经济部门，且基于此构建的组合在多种波动状态与交易成本水平下持续优于相关性方法；配对统计检验支持这一增益源于图域与因子域的对齐。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If factor exposures capture structural links between assets more stably, diversification can act directly on the latent market structure rather than on observed co-movement and its finite-sample artefacts, potentially yielding more robust portfolios across volatility regimes and transaction cost levels.

cards.summaryEn: The authors build KernelMosaic, a dataset expressing tasks as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications and their intersections, curated via human-guided review and diversity-aware selection. An agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair and performance optimization using reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback to produce trajectories. After supervised fine-tuning on this data, a small open-source model improves KernelBench L1/L2/L3 correctness from 4%, 0% and 0% to 88%, 82% and 16%, with more tasks faster than PyTorch eager at every level; the authors argue trajectory supervision clearly outperforms direct-response supervision.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is confined to the authors' setup: results cover a single small open-source model fine-tuned on KernelBench L1–L3, where L3 correctness remains only 16%; dataset quality depends on human-guided review and a strong LLM agent, and the claim that trajectory supervision beats direct responses comes from this paper's training experiments, lacking independent replication and validation on broader tasks and model scales.
cards.originalTitle: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
cards.descriptionEn: The paper introduces KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and iterative trajectories, plus an agentic framework that guides a strong model through implementation, repair and optimization; supervised fine-tuning of a small open model yields large correctness gains on KernelBench.
cards.limitations: 证据限于作者的实验设置：仅报告单个小开源模型在 KernelBench L1–L3 上的微调结果，L3 正确率仍仅 16%；数据集质量依赖人类引导评审与强 LLM 智能体，轨迹监督优于直接回答的结论来自本文训练实验，尚缺独立复现与更广任务、模型规模的验证。
cards.description: 论文提出开放数据集 KernelMosaic，将多样 CUDA 任务与经校验的解法及迭代轨迹配对，并配套智能体框架指导强模型完成实现、纠错与性能优化；对小开源模型做监督微调后，KernelBench 三级正确率显著提升。
cards.titleEn: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，该工作提供了一条用策展轨迹监督提升通用模型 CUDA 核生成能力的路径，并显示迭代测试与修订的监督信号优于直接答案监督，对降低高性能核编写门槛具有参考价值。
cards.title: KernelMosaic：CUDA核生成的数据集与智能体框架
keyPointsEn: The dataset pairs CUDA tasks with verified solutions and iterative trajectories, with tasks spanning natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications and their intersections.
The agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair and performance optimization, aided by reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback.
After fine-tuning, the small open-source model reaches 88%, 82% and 16% correctness on KernelBench L1, L2 and L3, with the share of tasks faster than PyTorch eager rising at every level.
keyPoints: 数据集将 CUDA 任务与经校验的解法及迭代轨迹配对，任务涵盖自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格及其交集。
智能体框架引导强 LLM 经历实现、正确性修复与性能优化，并借助可复用 CUDA 指导与执行反馈。
小开源模型微调后在 KernelBench L1、L2、L3 正确率达 88%、82%、16%，各级快于 PyTorch eager 的任务占比均上升。
cards.summary: 作者构建 KernelMosaic 数据集，以自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格及其交集等形式表达任务，并用人类引导的评审与多样性选择进行筛选。配套智能体框架引导强 LLM 完成实现、正确性修复和性能优化，利用可复用 CUDA 指导与执行反馈生成轨迹。小开源模型经该数据监督微调后，在 KernelBench L1/L2/L3 上正确率由 4%、0%、0% 升至 88%、82%、16%，各级快于 PyTorch eager 的任务比例也提高；作者认为轨迹监督明显优于直接回答监督。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, the work offers a path to improve general-purpose models' CUDA kernel generation via curated trajectory supervision, and suggests iterative testing-and-revision signals outperform direct-answer supervision, which is relevant to lowering the barrier to writing high-performance kernels.

cards.summaryEn: The study addresses continuous-time mean-variance portfolio selection with unknown diffusion coefficients, using diffusion-process RL theory to learn a pre-committed strategy directly without estimating market parameters. For multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors, the authors design an algorithm and prove a sublinear regret bound in terms of the Sharpe ratio. An empirical comparison on S&P 500 constituents finds the proposed method consistently among the best, especially in a volatile bear market, and decisively better than model-based continuous-time counterparts.
cards.limitationsEn: The regret guarantee applies only to multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors; the general setting with observable factors and unknown coefficients provides only a general approach, without the same guarantee. Empirical findings are tied to S&P 500 constituents, selected metrics, and periods, and should not be generalized as universal superiority or investment advice.
cards.originalTitle: Mean--Variance Portfolio Selection by Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning: Algorithms, Regret Analysis, and Empirical Study
cards.descriptionEn: The paper develops a data-driven continuous-time reinforcement learning approach that directly learns a pre-committed mean-variance strategy when diffusion coefficients are unknown, avoiding market-coefficient estimation. It provides a sublinear regret bound for multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors and reports an empirical study on S&P 500 constituents showing strong relative performance, especially in a volatile bear market.
cards.limitations: 理论遗憾界仅针对无因子的多股票 Black-Scholes 市场；一般含可观测因子且系数未知的设定只给出通用方法框架，未说明同等保证。实证结论基于标普500成分股与特定指标、时期，不能外推为普遍优越或投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究提出一种数据驱动的连续时间强化学习（RL）方法，在扩散过程系数未知时直接学习预先承诺的均值-方差投资策略，而无需估计市场参数；其新意在于绕开系数学习，并在多股票 Black-Scholes 市场给出次线性遗憾界，随后用标普500成分股做实证，显示该方法在波动熊市中相对多种常用配置策略表现突出。
cards.titleEn: Continuous-Time RL for Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection: Model-Free Learning and Empirical Comparison
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法及其遗憾保证成立，则可在市场参数未知时绕开“先估计再优化”的两步流程，为连续时间均值-方差配置提供可直接从数据学习的替代路径，并为策略比较提供实证参照。
cards.title: 连续时间强化学习求解均值-方差组合选择：无模型学习与实证比较
keyPointsEn: A data-driven continuous-time RL method learns a pre-committed mean-variance strategy directly, without learning or estimating market coefficients.
For multi-stock Black-Scholes markets without factors, an algorithm is designed with a proven sublinear regret bound in terms of the Sharpe ratio.
An extensive empirical study on S&P 500 constituents compares the method with many widely used portfolio allocation strategies under common metrics.
keyPoints: 提出数据驱动的连续时间 RL 方法，直接学习预先承诺的均值-方差策略，不估计或学习市场系数。
在无因子多股票 Black-Scholes 市场设计算法，并给出以夏普比率表示的次线性遗憾界。
在标普500成分股上开展广泛实证，与多种常用组合配置策略在多项指标下比较。
cards.summary: 研究对象是系数未知的连续时间均值-方差组合选择问题，作者基于扩散过程强化学习理论，直接学习预先承诺策略而不估计市场参数。针对无因子的多股票 Black-Scholes 市场，作者设计算法并证明以夏普比率刻画的次线性遗憾界。实证在标普500成分股上比较大量配置策略，作者称所提方法整体靠前，尤其在波动熊市中优势明显，并显著优于基于模型的连续时间对照方法。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the method and its regret guarantee hold, market parameters need not be estimated before optimization, offering a data-driven alternative for continuous-time mean-variance allocation and an empirical benchmark for strategy comparison.

cards.summaryEn: The paper studies what changes when deflation is embedded inside an autonomous search loop, so that the acceptance threshold becomes an object the search can optimize against. It analytically shows a variance-dilution effect: mediocre near-duplicate candidates lower the bar because the ledger's dispersion falls faster than its trial-count factor grows. The author proposes a pre-registered variance floor and a monotone high-water-mark bar, and audits 53 hundred-candidate searches under a frozen protocol; gated searches report 'no certifiable discovery' in 36 of 37 runs, un-gated controls report a strategy in all 16, and every arm's out-of-sample confidence interval includes zero.
cards.limitationsEn: The results are scoped to the analyzed system (two frontier models, two universes, two feature spaces, and 53 hundred-candidate searches); the supporting studies on state-based stopping, adaptive budget, and stress tests are limited to this experimental setting; all out-of-sample confidence intervals include zero, so no certifiable significant strategy evidence is provided.
cards.originalTitle: Can a search hold its own bar? In-loop deflation and its exploits in autonomous strategy discovery
cards.descriptionEn: This paper moves backtest-overfitting correction (e.g., deflated Sharpe ratio) from after the search into the search loop, shows that a naive in-loop threshold admits a variance-dilution effect exploitable by the search, and proposes two defenses. It is useful for providing an auditable overfitting-control framework for LLM-driven autonomous strategy searches.
cards.limitations: 结果仅适用于所分析的系统（两个前沿模型、两个市场域、两个特征空间及53次百候选搜索）；支持性研究中的状态停止、自适应预算和压力测试结论均限于该实验设置；样本外置信区间均包含零，未提供可认证的显著策略证据。
cards.description: 本文提出将回测过拟合校正（如去膨胀夏普比率）从搜索结束后移入搜索循环内部，发现朴素内循环阈值会因方差稀释效应被搜索算法利用，并给出两种防御措施。其有用性在于为基于大语言模型的自主策略搜索提供了可审计的过拟合控制框架。
cards.titleEn: In-Loop Deflation in Autonomous Strategy Discovery: Defenses and Variance-Dilution Effect
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明，将过拟合校正嵌入搜索循环内部会引入新的可被搜索利用的漏洞，并提供了可审计的防御设计，对基于大语言模型的自主量化策略发现的可信度评估具有方法学意义。
cards.title: 搜索内循环去膨胀：自主策略发现中的防御与稀释效应
keyPointsEn: The author analytically shows that a naive in-loop threshold admits a variance-dilution effect, whereby near-duplicate candidates can lower the acceptance bar.
Two defenses are proposed—a pre-registered variance floor and a monotone high-water-mark bar—and all in-loop decisions are audited by replaying from recorded traces under a frozen protocol.

Audit results show that gated searches report no certifiable discovery in 36 of 37 runs, un-gated controls report a strategy in all 16, and every arm's out-of-sample confidence interval includes zero.
keyPoints: 作者从解析上证明朴素内循环阈值存在方差稀释效应，即近重复候选可降低通过门槛。
提出预注册方差下限和单调高水位阈值两种防御，并在冻结协议下重放所有内循环决策进行审计。
审计结果显示带门控搜索的37次运行中36次报告无可认证发现，而无门控对照的16次运行均报告策略，且所有组样本外置信区间包含零。
cards.summary: 论文研究当把去膨胀校正内嵌到自主搜索循环中时，阈值本身成为可优化对象，并分析出一种方差稀释效应：平庸的近重复候选会因账本离散度下降快于试验数增长而拉低门槛。作者提出预注册方差下限与单调高水位阈值两种防御，并在冻结协议下审计了53次百候选搜索，发现带门控的搜索在37次运行中有36次报告“无可认证发现”，而无门控对照在全部16次中均报告策略，但所有组的样本外置信区间均包含零。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shows that embedding overfitting correction inside the search loop introduces a new exploitable loophole and offers an auditable defense design, which is methodologically relevant for assessing the credibility of LLM-driven autonomous quantitative strategy discovery.

cards.summaryEn: The paper studies real-time bidding decisions for marketing agencies balancing campaign performance and transaction margins under budget constraints. The key difficulty is that clearing prices are observed only when bids succeed, making available information policy-dependent; the authors model this as continuous-time stochastic control and construct price signals via parallel exploratory subcampaigns with randomized bids. They propose a model-based approach combining calibration and HJB iteration, and a model-free entropy-regularized actor-critic method, illustrated with synthetic experiments.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on a stylized cross-sectional sampling model and synthetic experiments, with no validation on real advertising auction data; consistency and mean-square error bounds of the price estimator rely on modeling assumptions, and real-world non-stationarity and strategic interactions are not tested; model-free method performance is shown only in synthetic environments, so practical deployment performance cannot be inferred.
cards.originalTitle: Media Trading with Censored Auction Prices: A Stochastic Control and Reinforcement Learning Approach
cards.descriptionEn: This study addresses the information constraint in real-time bidding where clearing prices are observed only upon winning bids, proposing a continuous-time stochastic control model with exploratory subcampaigns to estimate price signals, and providing both model-based and model-free solution methods.
cards.limitations: 证据基于风格化横截面采样模型与合成实验，未报告真实广告拍卖数据上的验证；价格估计量的一致性和均方误差界依赖建模假设，实际市场非平稳性与策略交互影响未被检验；无模型方法的效果仅在合成环境展示，尚不能推断实际部署性能。
cards.description: 该研究针对实时竞价中仅获胜时才能观测清算价格的信息约束，提出连续时间随机控制模型与探索性子活动估计价格信号，并给出基于模型和无模型两类求解方法。
cards.titleEn: Censored Auction Prices in Media Trading: A Stochastic Control and Reinforcement Learning Framework
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架明确区分完全信息基准、估计价格策略与真正部分观测控制问题，有助于理解实时竞价中信息获取与决策优化的权衡，并为截断观测下的价格信号构建提供可分析路径。
cards.title: 媒体交易中截断拍卖价格：随机控制与强化学习框架
keyPointsEn: Under a continuous-time stochastic control framework, censored auction prices are treated as a latent price process, and decision information depends on the bidding policy.
Price estimators are constructed via parallel exploratory subcampaigns with randomized bids, and are consistent with a mean-square error bound of order N^{-1} under a cross-sectional sampling model.
Two solution paths are given: a model-based approach with calibration, HJB policy iteration, and a physics-informed neural network; and a model-free entropy-regularized actor-critic method.
keyPoints: 在连续时间随机控制框架下，将截断拍卖价格视为潜在价格过程，决策信息依赖竞价策略。
通过并行探索性子活动随机化出价，构造价格估计量，在横截面采样模型下具有一致性与N^{-1}均方误差界。
给出基于模型的校准+HJB策略迭代+物理信息神经网络，以及无模型熵正则演员-评论家两条求解路径。
cards.summary: 论文研究营销机构在预算约束下平衡广告效果与交易利润的实时竞价决策。关键难点在于清算价格仅在竞价成功时被观测，导致信息依赖策略；作者用连续时间随机控制建模，并通过并行探索性子活动随机出价构造价格信号。作者提出基于模型的校准与HJB迭代方法以及无模型熵正则演员-评论家方法，并用合成实验说明。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework distinguishes full-information benchmarks, estimated-price policies, and the genuinely partially observed control problem, helping clarify the trade-off between information acquisition and decision optimization in real-time bidding, and offering an analyzable path for constructing price signals under censored observations.

cards.summaryEn: The paper extends the myopic rolling intrinsic policy for BESS trading in continuous intraday markets with distributional price forecasts. A novel target variable is derived from limit order book dynamics, and high-frequency simulations for 2023–2024 show profit improvements up to 42% over the naive policy. The study also finds an inverse relationship between forecast accuracy and stability, and that BESS size and duration jointly affect profitability and the marginal benefit of forecasts.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on high-frequency simulations for 2023–2024 without real-market deployment; the inverse accuracy-stability relationship and the roles of BESS size/duration require further empirical validation; market impact and strategy capacity constraints are not discussed.
cards.originalTitle: Improving Algorithmic Trading for BESS on Intraday Electricity Markets through Distributional Price Forecasts
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a distributional price forecasting method tailored to battery energy storage system (BESS) trading in intraday electricity markets, using a novel target variable from limit order book dynamics to extend the myopic rolling intrinsic policy and improve profits.
cards.limitations: 结论基于2023-2024年高频模拟，未涉及真实市场部署；预测精度与稳定性的反向关系及电池规模/时长的作用需进一步实证检验；未讨论市场冲击与策略容量等实际约束。
cards.description: 该研究提出一种面向电池储能系统（BESS）日内交易问题的分布价格预测方法，通过新型目标变量捕捉限价订单簿动态，扩展短视滚动内在策略，以提升交易利润。
cards.titleEn: Distributional Price Forecasts for BESS Trading in Intraday Electricity Markets
cards.whyItMatters: 为BESS在日内市场灵活变现提供计算高效且收益显著的预测增强方案，有助于理解预测质量与交易绩效的关系。
cards.title: 基于分布价格预测的日内市场电池交易优化
keyPointsEn: Introduces a novel forecast target derived from limit order book dynamics, tailored to BESS trading.
Embeds distributional forecasts into the myopic rolling intrinsic policy, avoiding full stochastic optimization.
High-frequency simulations show up to 42% profit improvement over the naive policy, with analysis of accuracy-stability trade-off and battery size/duration effects.
keyPoints: 提出从限价订单簿动态衍生的新预测目标，更贴合BESS交易需求。
将分布预测嵌入短视滚动内在策略，避免完整随机优化。
高频模拟显示利润较朴素策略提升最高42%，并分析精度-稳定性权衡及电池规模/时长的影响。
cards.summary: 论文针对BESS在连续日内市场的交易问题，提出一种融合分布价格预测的滚动内在策略扩展。作者基于限价订单簿构造新预测目标，并在2023-2024年高频模拟中验证利润提升最高达42%。研究还揭示了预测精度与稳定性之间的反向关系，以及BESS规模与时长对预测边际收益的联合影响。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides a computationally efficient, forecast-enhanced approach for BESS to monetize flexibility in intraday markets, and sheds light on the relationship between forecast quality and trading performance.

cards.summaryEn: Fact: DHRL defines a belief-equivalence relation over augmented state spaces via MDP homomorphisms, yielding exact abstraction under deterministic dynamics and approximate abstraction under stochastic dynamics, providing a unified abstraction mechanism for actor and critic. Author view: exact abstraction preserves optimality and recovers the delay-free sample-complexity order in finite domains, approximate abstraction admits a value-loss bound, and D²HPG outperforms augmentation-based baselines on MuJoCo, especially in long-delay regimes.
cards.limitationsEn: Theoretical guarantees are mainly limited to finite domains: exact abstraction requires deterministic dynamics, while stochastic dynamics only yields approximate abstraction with a value-loss bound; continuous-domain experiments are confined to MuJoCo benchmarks and do not cover real-system delay distributions or high-dimensional complex tasks, requiring further validation before deployment.
cards.originalTitle: Delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning for environments with delayed feedback
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning (DHRL), which uses MDP homomorphisms to collapse control-redundant augmented states into a compact abstract state space, unifying sample-complexity relief for both actor and critic; it preserves optimality and recovers delay-free sample-complexity order in finite domains, and its deep instantiation D²HPG outperforms strong augmentation baselines on MuJoCo long-delay tasks.
cards.limitations: 理论保证主要限定于有限域：精确抽象要求确定性动态，随机动态仅得近似抽象与价值损失界；连续域实验仅在MuJoCo基准进行，未覆盖真实系统延迟分布或高维复杂任务，实际部署需额外验证。
cards.description: 提出延迟同态强化学习（DHRL），用MDP同态将增广状态空间中的控制冗余状态折叠为紧凑抽象状态，统一缓解演员与评论家的样本复杂度负担；在有限域中保持最优性并恢复无延迟样本复杂度阶，连续域实例化D²HPG在MuJoCo长延迟任务上优于强增广基线。
cards.titleEn: Delayed Homomorphic Reinforcement Learning: Compressing Action Histories for Delayed Feedback
cards.whyItMatters: 延迟反馈破坏马尔可夫假设，增广方法面临状态空间爆炸与样本复杂度负担；DHRL提供统一抽象机制同时惠及演员与评论家，为长延迟连续控制提供可验证的理论起点与开源实现。
cards.title: 延迟同态强化学习：压缩动作历史以应对延迟反馈
keyPointsEn: DHRL uses MDP homomorphisms and a belief-equivalence relation to compress control-redundant augmented states into a compact abstract space.
In finite domains, exact abstraction preserves optimality and recovers delay-free sample-complexity order, while approximate abstraction yields a value-loss bound.
The continuous-domain instantiation D²HPG outperforms strong augmentation baselines on MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, especially in long-delay regimes.
keyPoints: DHRL利用MDP同态引入信念等价关系，将控制冗余的增广状态压缩为紧凑抽象空间。
有限域中精确抽象保持最优性并恢复无延迟样本复杂度阶，近似抽象给出价值损失上界。
连续域实例化D²HPG在MuJoCo连续控制基准上，尤其长延迟区间，优于强增广基线。
cards.summary: 事实：DHRL基于MDP同态定义信念等价关系，对增广状态空间做精确（确定性动态）或近似（随机动态）抽象，为演员和评论家提供统一抽象机制。作者观点：该框架能在有限域保持最优性并恢复无延迟样本复杂度阶，近似抽象可界定策略价值损失；D²HPG在MuJoCo长延迟区间优于增广基线。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Delayed feedback violates the Markov assumption, and augmentation-based methods suffer from state-space explosion and sample-complexity burden; DHRL offers a unified abstraction mechanism benefiting both actor and critic, providing a theoretically grounded starting point and open-source implementation for long-delay continuous control.

cards.summaryEn: MLIRBench uses a multi-agent pipeline to generate program mutations and execution-validate 1,768 torch and linalg program pairs labeled as equivalent, divergent, or error. Evaluating nine LLMs, the authors find that Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the highest hard-label accuracy of 92.65%, yet its aggregate execution-behavior score is only 5.04/10. The authors conclude that strong semantic classification does not necessarily imply accurate prediction of detailed execution behavior, revealing a gap in current LLM reasoning over compiler IRs.
cards.limitationsEn: The study evaluates only nine LLMs on a specific set of MLIR program pairs, so whether the conclusions generalize to other IRs or broader tasks remains unclear; scoring relies on automated judgments and a judge model, which may introduce bias; the dataset's size and program diversity are limited and cannot fully represent the complexity of real compilation scenarios.
cards.originalTitle: MLIRBench - A Benchmark and Dataset for Compiler and Hardware-Aware Reasoning
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces MLIRBench, an execution-validated dataset of program pairs designed to assess whether large language models truly understand the semantics and execution behavior of MLIR programs rather than relying on patterns learned from training data.
cards.limitations: 该研究仅评估了九个大语言模型在特定 MLIR 程序对上的表现，结论是否适用于其他 IR 或更广泛任务尚不明确；评分依赖自动判定与评判模型，可能引入偏差；数据集规模与程序多样性有限，不能完全代表真实编译场景的复杂性。
cards.description: 该研究提出 MLIRBench，一个基于执行验证的程序对数据集，用于评估大语言模型是否真正理解 MLIR 程序的语义与执行行为，而非仅依赖训练数据中的模式。
cards.titleEn: MLIRBench: Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Compiler Intermediate Representations
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准为研究大语言模型是否真正理解编译器中间表示提供了可复现的评估基础，有助于揭示模型在程序语义推理上的局限，并推动程序修复与语义分类等相关任务的研究。
cards.title: MLIRBench：评估大语言模型对编译器中间表示的推理能力
keyPointsEn: MLIRBench contains 1,768 execution-validated MLIR program pairs covering torch and linalg programs.
Among nine LLMs, Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the highest hard-label accuracy of 92.65%, but its aggregate execution-behavior score is only 5.04/10.
The results show a clear gap between semantic classification performance and the ability to predict detailed execution behavior.
keyPoints: MLIRBench 包含 1,768 个经执行验证的 MLIR 程序对，覆盖 torch 和 linalg 两类程序。
九个大语言模型中，Gemini 3.1 Pro 取得最高硬标签准确率 92.65%，但综合执行行为评分仅 5.04/10。
结果表明语义分类表现与详细执行行为预测能力之间存在明显差距。
cards.summary: MLIRBench 通过多智能体流水线生成程序变异，并利用执行验证构建 1,768 个 torch 与 linalg 程序对，标注为等价、分歧或错误。作者测试了九个大语言模型，发现 Gemini 3.1 Pro 在硬标签准确率上达到 92.65%，但整体执行行为评分仅为 5.04/10。作者据此认为，强语义分类能力并不必然意味着能准确预测详细执行行为，当前模型在编译器 IR 推理上仍存在差距。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark provides a reproducible foundation for studying whether LLMs truly understand compiler intermediate representations, helping to expose limitations in program semantic reasoning and to advance related tasks such as program repair and semantic classification.

cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that mainstream dialogue memory systems rely on passive semantic similarity over external fact stores, often missing relationally pivotal experiences. Inspired by cognitive psychology's Self-Memory System, the authors propose MindMem, which asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into mental states of the character, user, and relationship, invoked by a specialized reasoner at each turn. On MemReal-Bench, MindMem achieves 59.03% SMR and 82.58% DQA, exceeding the strongest baseline by 24.19 and 9.19 percentage points, respectively.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the authors' own MemReal-Bench benchmark and reported comparisons; no independent replication or ablation details across models and scenarios are provided, so the generalization and long-term stability of mental-state modeling require external validation.
cards.originalTitle: We Are What We Remember: Mental-State-Driven Memory for Long-Term Character Dialogue
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes MindMem, a framework that asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into mental states of the character, user, and relationship to anticipate latent user needs; it also releases MemReal-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark, and reports a 24.19 percentage-point gain over the strongest baseline on situated memory realization.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自论文自建的MemReal-Bench基准和作者报告的对比结果；未提供跨模型、跨场景的独立复现或消融细节，心智状态建模的泛化能力与长期稳定性尚需外部验证。
cards.description: 新研究提出MindMem框架，将共享经历异步整合为角色、用户及关系的心智状态，以预测用户潜在需求；同时发布MemReal-Bench纵向基准，并报告其在情境记忆实现任务上较最强基线提升24.19个百分点。
cards.titleEn: Mental-State-Driven Memory Framework Improves Long-Term Character Dialogue
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将对话记忆从事实检索转向关系性心智状态建模，为长期角色对话中理解用户潜在需求和自然使用共享历史提供了可评估的框架与基准。
cards.title: 心智状态驱动记忆框架提升长期角色对话表现
keyPointsEn: MindMem asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into three types of mental states—character, user, and relationship—rather than storing facts alone.
A specialized mental-state reasoner invokes persistent states at each turn to anticipate latent user needs and recover pivotal episodic evidence.
MemReal-Bench is grounded in months of real-user interactions and pairs direct question answering with situated memory realization to evaluate history-sensitive adaptation.
keyPoints: MindMem将共享经历异步巩固为角色、用户及关系三类心智状态，而非仅存储事实。
专门心智状态推理器在每轮对话中调用持久状态，预测潜在用户需求并恢复关键情节证据。
MemReal-Bench基准基于数月真实用户互动，结合直接问答与情境记忆实现两项任务评估历史敏感适应能力。
cards.summary: 论文指出主流对话记忆系统依赖被动语义相似度检索外部事实存储，常遗漏关系关键经历。作者受认知心理学自我记忆系统启发，提出MindMem，将共享经历异步巩固为角色、用户和关系的心智状态，并由专门推理器在每轮对话中调用。实验显示MindMem在MemReal-Bench上取得59.03%的SMR和82.58%的DQA，分别超过最强基线24.19和9.19个百分点。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shifts dialogue memory from fact retrieval toward relational mental-state modeling, offering an evaluable framework and benchmark for understanding latent user needs and naturally using shared history in long-term character dialogue.

cards.summaryEn: The project is maintained by the Google Chrome team, and its source description says it helps keep coding agents informed of current web best practices. Based on the available information, it is positioned as a guidance source for AI coding tools rather than a standalone tutorial for human readers. The summary does not specify the practice list, the update mechanism, or how agents integrate with it.
cards.limitationsEn: The available input contains only the repository name, the source platform, a one-line source summary, and a publication date. It lacks README details, a list of practice entries, update frequency, agent integration methods, or usage examples. Coverage, authority, and practicality cannot be judged, nor can the actual impact on code-generation quality be evaluated.
cards.descriptionEn: The Google Chrome team has published modern-web-guidance-src on GitHub, positioned as a way to keep coding agents up to date with the latest web best practices. Its value lies in packaging front-end best practices as a refreshable source that AI coding assistants can consult, instead of relying on stale training knowledge.
cards.limitations: 现有输入仅包含仓库名、来源平台、一条源摘要和发布时间，没有 README 细节、实践条目清单、更新频率、智能体接入方式或使用案例。因此无法判断指南的覆盖面、权威程度与可操作性，也不能据此评估其对代码生成质量的实际影响。
cards.description: Google Chrome 团队在 GitHub 发布 modern-web-guidance-src 项目，定位是让编码智能体持续获取最新的 Web 最佳实践。它的价值在于把前端最佳实践整理成可按需更新的源，供 AI 编码助手在生成代码时参考，而非依赖过时的训练知识。
cards.titleEn: GoogleChrome Opens Source Repo for Modern Web Guidance
cards.whyItMatters: AI 编码助手常受训练数据时效限制，容易输出过时的前端写法。若指南源能持续更新并被智能体接入，有助于减少此类落后实践。但当前仅凭仓库标题与一句话摘要，无法确认覆盖范围和实际接入效果。
cards.title: GoogleChrome 开源现代 Web 实践指南源
keyPointsEn: Aimed at keeping coding agents in sync with current web best practices
Maintained by the Google Chrome team on GitHub
Sits at the intersection of AI tooling and front-end development guidance
keyPoints: 定位是让编码智能体同步最新的 Web 最佳实践
由 Google Chrome 团队在 GitHub 维护
属于 AI 工具与前端开发交叉方向的指南源项目
cards.summary: 该项目由 Google Chrome 团队维护，源描述称其用途是让编码智能体保持对最新 Web 最佳实践的了解。就现有信息看，它被定位为面向 AI 编码工具的指南来源，而非面向人类独立阅读的完整教程。项目摘要未说明具体实践清单、更新机制或与智能体的接入方式。
cards.whyItMattersEn: AI coding assistants are often constrained by training-data recency and may produce outdated front-end patterns. A guidance source that is kept current and can be consumed by agents could help reduce such lag. However, from the repository title and one-line summary alone, the coverage and real integration effects cannot be confirmed.

cards.summaryEn: The repository positions itself as a workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents, covering shaping, deciding, planning, annotating, code review, team sharing and one-click feedback delivery to agents. These capabilities come from the repository description, which reflects the author's claims rather than independent evaluation.
cards.limitationsEn: The available information comes only from the GitHub Trending repository description, with no implementation details, documentation, evaluation data or user feedback. Its practical usability, compatibility with existing agent toolchains, and the accuracy and security of feedback delivery cannot be assessed, and this is not adoption or investment advice.
cards.descriptionEn: Plannotator is a workspace tool for collaborating with AI agents. Its novelty lies in combining shaping, deciding, planning, annotating, code review and team sharing in one interface, with one-click sending of all feedback back to agents. For teams using coding agents, this may help consolidate scattered human input into actionable signals.
cards.limitations: 现有信息仅来自 GitHub Trending 的仓库简介，未包含实现细节、使用文档、评测数据或用户反馈。因此无法判断其实际可用性、与现有智能体工具链的兼容性、反馈回传的准确性与安全性，也不构成采用或投资建议。

cards.descriptionEn: nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script for installing and switching between multiple active Node.js versions on a single machine. It provides developers with a simple and consistent way to switch versions, helping address different Node.js version requirements across projects.
